dedupe_keys.name: comreg quarterly key data report qkdr irish electronic communications market data

description: ComReg's Quarterly Key Data Report contains statistics on Ireland's electronic communications market collected each quarter from authorised operators. It covers subscriptions, revenue, broadband speeds sold, minutes and data usage for fixed voice, fixed broadband, mobile voice and mobile broadband; ComReg publishes a short PDF report on the key trends of each quarter and the full data on a data portal, with definitions included in the Excel files and a glossary of charts and tables in the report's annex. Not all operators are included, but ComReg aims to represent 95 per cent of the market. The national open data portal entry, created in 2020, links the data portal, the report page, an 'All data' Excel workbook for the second quarter of 2026 (about 0.6 MB) and ComReg's Open Data Map Hub. Coverage: Ireland. Format and access: XLSX and PDF, free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: operator-reported data covering most but not all of the market; ComReg's own website refused automated requests in this session. Simulation uses: quarterly subscription and traffic series for demand and capacity models of fixed and mobile networks in Ireland. Related records: the ComReg gigabit broadband coverage statistics give the spatial side, and the CSO data centre electricity data describe another part of Ireland's digital infrastructure.
name: ComReg Quarterly Key Data Report (QKDR): Irish electronic communications market data
notes: data.gov.ie CKAN metadata read on 2026-09-26 (description, licence, frequency, resources); workbook size from HTTP headers. comreg.ie returned HTTP 999 to curl. The start date of the series was not checked.
